description: Groups a review finding by kind so a relaunched worker gets one checklist per kind.
instructions: What kind of problem does this code-review finding describe?

criteria.tests_missing_or_weak: A required unit, UX or accessibility test is missing for a device family, or its assertions do not prove the fix
criteria.pattern_rule: The change breaks a rule of a registered pattern, or grows a parallel implementation of a canonical component
criteria.accessibility_behavior: Product accessibility behavior is wrong: VoiceOver focus, labels, reading order, traits, 44 pt targets, text scaling
criteria.blast_radius: The same fix was not applied to the other pages, sheets or device families with the same structure
criteria.web_parity: Behavior or entity ids diverge from the React dashboard without a recorded decision
criteria.docs_rules: Agent docs, pattern docs, mockups, contracts or DocC were not updated to match the change
criteria.system_api_first: Custom machinery where a system API on iOS 17, 18 or 26 fits, or a missing rung-0 note
criteria.propose_first: A visible change without a linked proposal and the owner's pick
criteria.performance_invariant: Breaks a performance invariant: per-frame state writes, main-thread work scaling with the house, reload on reopen
criteria.correctness: A logic, state, data or lifecycle bug in the change itself
criteria.process: Release-Note trailers, CI configuration, secrets, layering or other repository process requirements

output: jev_hints.py findings: groups a reviewer's findings into one checklist per kind for the relaunched worker.
evidence: Unmeasured on this repo's findings (build/review holds too few). The FestivalNativeApps measurement of the same question over 413 findings had median confidence 0.97. Used only to group findings; every finding still reaches the worker.
